\n', ) # AC-FR-001-2: default HTMLRenderer() with markdown link renderer_default = mistune.HTMLRenderer() md_default = mistune.create_markdown(renderer=renderer_default) self.assertEqual( md_default("[site](https://example.com)"), '

site

\n', ) # AC-FR-004-1: link_rel=None explicitly with markdown link renderer_none = mistune.HTMLRenderer(link_rel=None) md_none = mistune.create_markdown(renderer=renderer_none) self.assertEqual( md_none("[link](https://example.com)"), '

link

\n', ) def test_link_rel_autolinks(self): # AC-FR-002-1: angle bracket autolink with link_rel="nofollow ugc" renderer = mistune.HTMLRenderer(link_rel="nofollow ugc") md = mistune.create_markdown(renderer=renderer) self.assertEqual( md(""), '

\n', ) # AC-FR-002-2: url plugin autolink with link_rel="nofollow ugc" md_url = mistune.create_markdown(renderer=renderer, plugins=["url"]) self.assertEqual( md_url("https://example.com"), '

https://example.com

\n', ) def test_link_rel_image_isolation(self): # AC-FR-003-1: images should not receive rel attribute from link_rel renderer = mistune.HTMLRenderer(link_rel="nofollow ugc") md = mistune.create_markdown(renderer=renderer) self.assertEqual( md("![alt text](https://example.com/img.png)"), '

\n', ) def test_regression_link_with_title_and_escaping(self): # Regression: links with titles should include both title and rel attributes correctly renderer = mistune.HTMLRenderer(link_rel="nofollow ugc") md = mistune.create_markdown(renderer=renderer) self.assertEqual( md('[site](https://example.com "Example Title")'), '

site

\n', ) # Regression: default renderer with titles md_default = mistune.create_markdown() self.assertEqual( md_default('[site](https://example.com "Title")'), '

site

\n', ) def test_regression_nearby_inline_elements(self): # Regression: emphasis, code, and standard formatting remain unaffected md = mistune.create_markdown() self.assertEqual( md("*emphasis* and `code`"), '
